(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; Bloomberg's own reporting language)
Google is giving trade unions access to thousands of its UK employees, after Labour made it easier for unions to recruit new members. The US tech firm has agreed allow trade union Prospect into its UK offices, including its King's Cross headquarters.
(Other non-approved aggregators report the deal covers about 7,000 UK workers, including YouTube but excluding DeepMind — unverified on approved domain.)
